items.title: AI optimism is high among accounting firms. Change to pricing and business models is not—and talent disruption is still ahead.

That's the central finding from Volume 4 of the BILL accounting firm AI ambition survey, the final installment of a four-part research series produced with B2B research firm NewtonX and based on responses from more than 200 accounting firm leaders. This volume focuses on business model and pricing innovation—specifically how AI is reshaping firm structures, talent models, and revenue strategies.
